newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish garment maker Wistil eyes Q4 listing.
newsitem.headline: Polish garment maker Wistil eyes Q4 listing.

text.p: Polish garment maker Wistil SA plans a public offering and entry on the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse in the fourth quarter of this year, the firm's deputy president said on Friday.

"We plan our debut on the Warsaw bourse for the fourth quarter 1997...on the parallel market," Andrzej Urbaniak told Reuters, adding that there was no decision yet on how much capital would be raised in the offering. @
The firm, whose full name is Zaklady Przemyslu Jedwabniczego Wistil SA, is 33-percent owned by National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 13 in Poland's mass privatisation programme.
The remaining 14 funds in the NFI scheme hold 27 percent, the state treasury has 25 percent and the rest is held by employees.

Wistil, which specialises in synthetic knit goods, made a net profit of 4.5 million zlotys last year on sales of 120 million zlotys after netting 4.1 million zlotys in 1995 on sales of 106.3 million zlotys. @
